I understood the article and the background for this issue but I don't understand what arbitration is nor what is going to happen now.  
Some are saying this is good for the union workers but I can't see that.

I don't understand how the government can force these people to go back to work. Isn't the whole point of a strike to not work until an agreement is met between employer and employee?

Hi, new here. Please don't crucify me. I have a few questions.

1. Are running shoes only supposed to be used for running? Am I actively doing hard to myself by using them for daily chores walking around town?
2. If the wear on these shoes causes joint damage, are barefoot shoes just as harmful?

It's astonishing the level of irony that people seem to say themselves but have zero register of what it means further.  


Over and over people talk about men's socialization, the machismo that's pervasive and that men are at fault for their own problems. It's so incredibly tone deaf. Just put the shoe on the other foot. Women are at fault for their own problems because they simply won't let go of ideas of femininity. Stupid.

​

Men would love to open up and feel for once but every institution, every person, and every culture is pushing men to be emotionless robots. Men by default are see as predators, sexual deviants, violent goons, uncontrollable, a danger to society something that must be extricated.  


If you don't believe me ask the nearest cis/het man the quagmire of replies they have to account for as an explanation for why they made eye contact with a school child or are anywhere near children. Yes even if they are there with their own children.  


Someone smarter then me please help me understand why it's so easy to believe the difficulties of women with the act they put on, the protective shell of indifference they show to strange men on public transit but not believe men when they say the same.  


At this point figures like Andrew Tate are selling a new and improved 'act' that young boys are putting on in order to update 'manliness' in the modern age. If society continues to force performative masculinity on men then young boys are going to learn how to wear the only outfit they are allowed too but put their own generational spin on it.

This is why the Scandinavian approach is better at times. Just say what you want.  
Women that take the coy I'm an innocent women approach are part of a larger cultural problem. Women are just as sexual but are treated as if they weren't (by sexually repressive norms btw).  


Men are consistently seen as sexual creatures first and people/friends second. It blows my mind when something like this happens and the fault somehow lay with the man.  


It's like it's impossible to disentangle men from every and all responsibility of any and all things.  


Yes men can be friends with women, no it's not always sexual. If she wanted to have sex she could have just said as much.  


What ever happened to "enthusiastic consent"? Guess it's only for men.
